title: HiPHI: A Large-Scale Benchmark for High-Precision Human Motion and Object-Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2608.16222v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Humanoid intelligence requires learning over an extremely diverse space of whole-body motions and physically grounded interactions. However, existing embodied datasets remain fundamentally limited: internet-scale video data lack precise physical states and interaction grounding, while laboratory motion datasets provide high fidelity but only narrow behavioral coverage. This mismatch creates a critical bottleneck for scalable humanoid policy learning. We present HiPHI, a 600+ hour scale high-fidelity whole-body human motion dataset designed to systematically maximize coverage of the human motion and interaction manifold. HiPHI is theoretically guided by FrameNet, a linguistic framework organizing human primitives. Created using an optical motion capture pipeline, HiPHI provides sub-millimeter spatial marker tracking accuracy for full-body human motion and mesh-level object trajectories. translated_title: HiPHI：面向高精度人体运动与物体交互的大规模基准数据集
translated_abstract: 摘要：类人智能需要在极其多样化的全身运动及物理接地交互空间中进行学习。然而，现有具身数据集仍存在根本性限制：互联网规模的视频数据缺乏精确的物理状态和交互接地信息，而实验室运动数据集虽提供高保真度，但行为覆盖范围狭窄。这种不匹配为可扩展的类人策略学习造成了关键瓶颈。我们提出了HiPHI，一个超过600小时规模的高保真全身人体运动数据集，旨在系统性地最大化人体运动与交互流形的覆盖范围。HiPHI在理论上受FrameNet框架指导，该语言框架用于组织人类行为基元。通过光学动作捕捉流程构建，HiPHI提供亚毫米级空间标记追踪精度，用于全身人体运动及网格级物体轨迹。我们进一步引入一套基准测试套件，用于评估...
tldr: HiPHI是一个超过600小时的高保真人体运动数据集，通过光学捕捉实现亚毫米精度，并以FrameNet理论为指导，旨在系统性覆盖人体运动和交互多样性，突破现有数据集在物理状态和交互接地方面的瓶颈。
en_tdlr: HiPHI is a 600+ hour high-fidelity human motion dataset with sub-millimeter optical capture accuracy, guided by FrameNet theory, aiming to systematically cover human motion and interaction diversity to overcome bottlenecks in physical state and interaction grounding.
